evidence.quote: Nb–16Si, Nb-16Si-1Zr and Nb-16Si-2Zr alloys consist of a large primary Nbss phase and the eutectic mixtures of Nbss/(Nb, Zr)3Si. The eutectic mixtures of Nbss/(Nb, Zr)3Si is very fine, and the average size of Nbss phase is only 1 μm.
